title: Horizon Cost Sprint: bin-packing and per-route quantization field lab
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Run a constrained field lab to validate three complementary cost levers: adaptive micro-batch bin-packing, per-route (usage-profile) quantization profiles, and KV cache TTL heuristics. The intent is to produce deterministic, auditable recommendations that product teams can opt into per-route via the Console, with measurable unit-econ improvements and strict latency guardrails. We will onboard 3 pilot customers (internal staging, external partner A, external partner B) and exercise a mixture of synthetic and production traffic for 4 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: >=12% median token cost reduction for pilot routes without >5% p50 latency regression
Quantization profiles validated across 3 model families with end-to-end quality checks (A/B tests on prompt sets)
Bin-packing strategy demonstrates stable throughput gains under 95th percentile concurrency scenarios
KV cache TTL heuristics reduce redundant model compute (measured by cache-hit delta) and show no increase in error-rate/serving anomalies
Console toggles for per-route recommendations surfaced and a rollout path documented (canary -> full rollout)
Runbook and rollback plan documented; relevant security and audit stamps collected
